tasks.answer: Delete confirmation uses ConfirmationDialog (delete-discussion.tsx wraps a destructive Button trigger + destructive confirm Button). Required: triggerButton (ReactElement), confirmButton (ReactElement), title (string); body, cancelButtonText, icon ('danger'|'info'), isDone are optional. Barrel @/components/ui/dialog re-exports it from dialog/confirmation-dialog.

Login form uses Input from @/components/ui/form. Binding: the Form render-prop supplies react-hook-form's register, passed as registration={register('email')} / register('password') plus error={formState.errors[...]}. Input spreads {...registration} (UseFormRegisterReturn: name/onChange/onBlur/ref) onto the native <input>, so registration is the only TS-required prop; label/error are optional FieldWrapper pass-throughs.

Discussions list passes pagination={{totalPages: meta.totalPages, currentPage: meta.page, rootUrl: ''}} into Table, which renders TablePagination. TablePaginationProps = {totalPages: number; currentPage: number; rootUrl: string} (required); hrefs are built as `${rootUrl}?page=N`. Note: TablePagination is NOT re-exported by the @/components/ui/table barrel (only Table + Table types); import it from @/components/ui/table/pagination. Table itself takes data, columns, and optional pagination.

MDPreview renders sanitized Markdown via marked parse + DOMPurify.sanitize into dangerouslySetInnerHTML. Its single input prop is value: string (defaults to ''), used as <MDPreview value={discussion.body} /> in discussion-view.tsx.

CreateDiscussion is a no-prop FormDrawer + Form (title Input, body Textarea) that calls useCreateDiscussion. It is gated by <Authorization allowedRoles={[ROLES.ADMIN]}> (ROLES.ADMIN from @/lib/authorization), so only ADMIN users can see/use it.

notes: No component catalog exists in this checkout (component-catalog.json / component-catalog.config.json absent); no catalog CLI used. Strategy: listed apps/react-vite/src tree, then read component sources by feature (discussions, auth) and their barrels, verifying exports by grep. Grep also only matched (not fully read) features/users/components/delete-user.tsx, features/comments/components/delete-comment.tsx, app/routes/app/discussions/discussions.tsx, and lib/__tests__/authorization.test.tsx; those bytes are excluded from totalBytesRead. Key uncertainty: TablePagination is not re-exported from the @/components/ui/table barrel, so its importPath is @/components/ui/table/pagination even though consumers usually only pass pagination to Table. Other apps' duplicate components ignored.
